top_signals.title: Lula Sounds Out Bradesco’s Luiz Trabuco to Join His Government
top_signals.summary: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has sounded out Bradesco Chairman Luiz Carlos Trabuco Cappi about joining his fourth-term government, according to people familiar with the matter, a move that could help ease investor concerns over Brazil’s deteriorating fiscal outlook.

top_signals.title: Australia Capex Surges by Most Since Mining Boom on Data Centers
top_signals.summary: Australian business investment surged by the most since the peak of the mining boom in the three months through September, driven by data center-related spending in a bright spot for an otherwise cooling economy.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
